title: Design exercise: SAA-2.2-S04
scenario: Wexcombe Pharmacy Chain's refill portal serves 120 stores, and its current inventory is one web and application server, one NAT gateway that the private subnets in both of its Availability Zones route through, one database instance with no standby, and one job server that renders labels. Last month a hardware fault in the zone hosting these components blocked refills for 5 hours, which is more than half of the roughly 525 minutes (about 8.8 hours) a year that a 99.9 percent target allows. The chain will accept at most a doubling of the monthly run-rate. No application rewrite is planned.
constraints: Do not claim live AWS experience
Finance accepts at most a doubling of the monthly run-rate
No application rewrite is planned; the design may duplicate or replace infrastructure around the application but not change its code
Pharmacy operations cannot accept another outage of more than a few minutes from one component failing

rubric.label: Every one of the four listed single points of failure is addressed
The design keeps at most two copies of any current component (one per Availability Zone) and names every added component with why the run-rate is still expected to stay within double

constraint_reason: Mapped as design_exercise to complete skill coverage when no dedicated live lab step exists
